Both the inline freight panel and the Freight Dashboard modal only expose FOB tiles for Will-Call and Ship (testids tile-fob-willcall, tile-fob-ship, dash-fob-willcall, dash-fob-ship). No tile/control sets quoteFOB='LocalDelivery'. Code path in Placeholders.jsx PricingStrategySec (L40-49) does support this value, but the UI does not surface it.

critical_code_review_comments: FOB control surface is incomplete vs. code support: PricingStrategySec.freightPart handles quoteFOB==='LocalDelivery' but neither freight-panel nor FreightDashModal renders a Local Delivery option. Either expose tile-fob-localdelivery (and dash-fob-localdelivery), or remove the unreachable code path. Main agent should reconcile.

Section header click target: clicking the outer container with data-testid='sec-production' / 'sec-item-setup' does NOT toggle collapse — the onClick lives on the inner .sp-sec-head. This is fine for normal users (they click the header strip), but worth noting for test authors. Testing agents must use [data-testid='sec-...'] .sp-sec-head as the toggle handle.
ItemSetupSec.jsx is 1012 lines (carry-over from iteration_54) — still > 700-line threshold; recommend split.
action_items: Expose a LocalDelivery FOB tile in the freight panel and/or FreightDashModal so the existing 'Freight - Local Delivery' summary string in PricingStrategySec can actually be reached from the UI. Suggested testids: tile-fob-localdelivery and dash-fob-localdelivery. Without this, the acceptance criterion cannot be re-validated by future testing.
Optional: consider routing the outer sec-* data-testid container's onClick through to onToggle, or document that .sp-sec-head is the click target.

rca of the issue: FOB LocalDelivery acceptance: PricingStrategySec.jsx (~L40) checks quoteFOB==='LocalDelivery' and returns 'Freight - Local Delivery', but there is no UI affordance to set quoteFOB to that value. The visible FOB tiles are limited to Will-Call and Ship (in both the inline freight panel and the FreightDashModal). To enable the test, add a LocalDelivery tile and wire its onClick to setField('quoteFOB','LocalDelivery').
